product.olivetti-philos-44-color.summary: The active-matrix Philos 44 added a dedicated numeric keypad and voice recording.
product.olivetti-philos-44-color.history: The 44C was the colour version of the Philos 44, the high-end model in the 1993 ad. BYTE tested a US$3,720 unit in March 1994. Access advertised its configuration at C$5,195 in May.
product.olivetti-philos-44-color.archite: The hinged keyboard made the removable disk accessible. BYTE tested a 25 MHz 486SL, and Access advertised a 486 SL-33 (DX) for the 44 line.
product.olivetti-philos-44-color.verifie: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-44-color.limitat: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
